Giant flowering plant-pod that swallows mortals and grows an emotionless pod- clone of the victim.

AC 7, HP 48, ATK 3 bite (near) +7 (2d8 + swallow), MV close, S +4, D -3, C +3, I +3, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 10

Pod Person. The bodythief can consume a corpse and produce an emotionless pod person clone of that person. Exact duplicate of mortal but chaotic, dull, and vapid.

Swallow. On a natural attack roll of 18-20, target is swallowed. Total darkness inside and 2d10 damage per round. Regurgitates all swallowed if dealt at least 20 damage in one round to the inside of its gullet.
